name: Fairchild KR Biplane
summary: Late-1920s two-seat sport and training biplane from Hagerstown; a few dozen remain on the registry.

wings: Staggered biplane with interplane struts and bracing wires
engines: Radial engine (Kinner, Warner or Wright), usually uncowled
fuselage: Two tandem open cockpits with the pilot at the rear
tail: Rounded fin and rudder with a tailskid

tellTales: Small tandem open-cockpit biplane with an uncowled radial
Staggered wings with strut-and-wire bracing and a tailskid
Light sport-trainer biplane of the late 1920s

confusedWith.howToTell: The two are alike in size and layout; the Fleet Models 2 and 7 have a distinctive looped radius rod on the port main gear leg.
The Stearman is much larger with a heavy radial; the Fairchild is a small, light biplane.
The Waco 10 has a wide passenger cockpit under the wing ahead of the pilot; the Fairchild has two narrow tandem cockpits.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
